output.reason: [ev-d4a0f83c6c05] says only that Istio 1.24.0 adds the app.kubernetes.io/* and helm.sh/chart labels to almost all resources. Nothing in it ties this to a Kubernetes version, so the cluster-version ">=1.0.0" operand is an unsupported filler. It adds nothing, and under three-valued logic it can leave environments unknown when their cluster version can't be seen. The evidence supports exposure for any environment upgrading from a release before 1.24.0. It doesn't say which resources are excluded, so no narrower rendered-change predicate can be written.

correction.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds the app.kubernetes.io/name, app.kubernetes.io/instance, app.kubernetes.io/part-of, app.kubernetes.io/version, app.kubernetes.io/managed-by and helm.sh/chart labels to almost all resources. Any environment upgrading from a version before 1.24.0 gets these labels.
